articles.title: Arman Tsarukyan Has ONE Goal: Become UFC Champion #ufc
articles.description: Arman Tsarukyan has one goal—and he isn’t letting anything distract him from it: becoming UFC champion. Chael Sonnen reveals his conversation with Arman about preparing for five rounds, staying active in wrestling and jiu-jitsu, and balancing those competitions with his MMA training. Arman’s answer was simple: no matter how big another match is, he never stops training MMA. That mindset is what makes Tsarukyan different. articles.title: This Is Why I Love Wrestling
articles.description: Sometimes in wrestling, you only need one good day. Chael Sonnen tells the story of Blaine Natal, a wrestler he's known and coached for years. Blaine has spent his life showing up, taking the hard matches and refusing to let failure determine whether he steps on the mat again. His mother, Candy, has been there for all of it. But for all the years of work, Blaine was still waiting for that day. Then he drew Noah Wachsmuth, an undefeated Oregon champion and former Olympic Training Center athlete. On paper, this wasn't supposed to be Blaine's moment. For much of the match, it didn't look like it would be. But wrestling doesn't reward how impressive something looks. The scoreboard does the talking. When time expired, Blaine had one more point. After 22 years, he finally had his day. For Chael, it was one of those rare moments in sports that brought a tear to his eye. You don't need 10 years of perfect days. Sometimes you just need one. Tommy has the fighting ability, an authentic personality and the rare ability to deliver a promotional line without making it sound rehearsed. He also trains alongside O’Malley under Tim Welch, giving him access to people who understand that becoming a star requires more than winning fights. McMillen’s undefeated record survived another major test at Noche UFC when he defeated Marwan Rahiki by unanimous decision in a back-and-forth fight.
